Assigning Contracts to Contract Accounts (IS-U)
Assigning Contracts to Contract Accounts (IS-U)
Procedure
Contracts are created in utilities when a move-in is entered (transaction EC50E). Contracts are automatically allocated to a contract account. You can either select an existing contract account or create a new one.
You can find more information in the section on
move-in
.
Result
Once you have saved the move-in, the number of the allocated contract account is stored in the contract.

Assigning Contracts to Contract Accounts (IS-U)
Procedure
Contracts are created in utilities when a move-in is entered (transaction EC50E). Contracts are automatically allocated to a contract account. You can either select an existing contract account or create a new one.
You can find more information in the section on move-in.
Result
Once you have saved the move-in, the number of the allocated contract account is stored in the contract.
